Arven.name: Arven
Arven.effect: Search your deck for an Item card and a Pokémon Tool card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

abilities.name: Seasoned Skill
abilities.effect: Blood Moon used by this Pokémon costs {C} less for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

attacks.name: Blood Moon
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

Boss's Orders.name: Boss's Orders
Boss's Orders.effect: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

Buddy-Buddy Poffin.name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin

attacks.name: Itchy Pollen
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

Counter Catcher.name: Counter Catcher
Counter Catcher.effect:
You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.

Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

Crispin.name: Crispin
Crispin.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards of different types, reveal them, and put 1 of them into your hand. Attach the other to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

Defiance Vest.name: Defiance Vest
Defiance Vest.effect: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, the Pokémon this card is attached to takes 40 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Phantom Dive
attacks.effect: Put 6 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

abilities.name: Recon Directive
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

abilities.name: Cursed Blast
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may put 5 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you use this Ability, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Come and Get You
attacks.effect: Put up to 3 Duskull from your discard pile onto your Bench.

Earthen Vessel.name: Earthen Vessel
Earthen Vessel.effect:
You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.

Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

abilities.name: Flip the Script
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Flip the Script Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Cruel Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

Forest Seal Stone.name: Forest Seal Stone
Forest Seal Stone.effect:
The Pokémon V this card is attached to can use the VSTAR Power on this card.
Star Alchemy
During your turn, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

Hawlucha.name: Hawlucha
Hawlucha.description: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

abilities.name: Flying Entry
abilities.effect: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and put 1 damage counter on each of them.

Iono.name: Iono
Iono.effect: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.

Jamming Tower.name: Jamming Tower
Jamming Tower.effect: Pokémon Tools attached to each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) have no effect.

attacks.name: Memory Lock
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.

Lance.name: Lance
Lance.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Dragon Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

abilities.name: Skyliner
abilities.effect: Your Basic Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Eon Blade
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

abilities.name: Luminous Sign
abilities.effect: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Aqua Return
attacks.effect: Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

Luminous Energy.name: Luminous Energy
Luminous Energy.effect:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

If the Pokémon this card is attached to has any other Special Energy attached, this card provides {C} Energy instead.

attacks.name: Double Eater
attacks.effect: Discard up to 2 Energy cards from your hand, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

abilities.name: Adrena-Brain
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has any {D} Energy attached, you may move up to 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

Neo Upper Energy.name: Neo Upper Energy
Neo Upper Energy.effect:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If this card is attached to a Stage 2 Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 2 Energy at a time.

Nest Ball.name: Nest Ball
Nest Ball.effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

Night Stretcher.name: Night Stretcher
Night Stretcher.effect: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

Professor Turo's Scenario.name: Professor Turo's Scenario
Professor Turo's Scenario.effect: Put 1 of your Pokémon in play into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that Pokémon.)

Professor's Research.name: Professor's Research
Professor's Research.effect: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.

Radiant Alakazam.name: Radiant Alakazam
Radiant Alakazam.description: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

abilities.name: Painful Spoons
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may move up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Ruler
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

Rescue Board.name: Rescue Board
Rescue Board.effect: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is {C} less. If that Pokémon's remaining HP is 30 or less, it has no Retreat Cost.

Super Rod.name: Super Rod
Super Rod.effect: Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

Switch.name: Switch
Switch.effect: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

Technical Machine: Devolution.name: Technical Machine: Devolution

attacks.name: Devolution
attacks.effect: Devolve each of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

Technical Machine: Devolution.effect: The Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn.

Temple of Sinnoh.name: Temple of Sinnoh
Temple of Sinnoh.effect: All Special Energy attached to Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) provide Colorless Energy and have no other effect.

Ultra Ball.name: Ultra Ball
Ultra Ball.effect:
You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.

Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

Unfair Stamp.name: Unfair Stamp
Unfair Stamp.effect:
You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.

Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 2 cards.
